research_notes: If state/current update fails after immutable close, the successor should reconcile but should not count that as a runtime close failure because the decisive checkpoint survived.
It is instead a summary-state maintenance fault.
This classification keeps the runtime boundary tied to durable work preservation rather than cache maintenance.
If immutable close itself fails with explicit repository error, classify non-duration unless evidence indicates elapsed termination caused it.
If the invocation disappears before attempting close, duration failure becomes more plausible near the boundary.
These distinctions will matter more at higher target classes.
